effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When one of your [Ghost] trait Digimon attacks, by suspending this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand. If attacking by ＜Execute＞, it may digivolve into a [Ghost] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
